definitions.short: Sabteca , the name of a son of Cush, and the region settled by him
definitions.full: H5455. Sabteka סַבְתְּכָא proper name, of a people 5th 'son' of Cush according to Gen 10:7 = 1Chr 1:9 ( הָ֯ according to Baer; אָ֯ , as Genesis, van d. H. Ginsb); location quite unknown; ᵑ6 Σαβακαθα , Σεβεκαθα .
